Package ke.ric.renderer.api

Record Class CaptureRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ke.ric.renderer.api.CaptureRequest
Record Components:
camera - camera position and world; defensively cloned
radius - finite positive capture radius in blocks
settings - output dimensions and rendering intent
chunksPerTick - maximum chunks whose state may be read in one server tick
excludedEntityIds - entity UUIDs omitted before visual capture; defensively copied
public record CaptureRequest(org.bukkit.Location camera, double radius, RenderSettings settings, int chunksPerTick, Set<UUID> excludedEntityIds) extends Record
Describes an asynchronous Paper-world capture centered on a camera location.

  • Method Details

    • camera

      public org.bukkit.Location camera()
      Returns a fresh copy of the camera location; changing it cannot alter this request.

    • at

      public static CaptureRequest at(org.bukkit.Location camera)
      Starts a capture with RenderSettings.defaults(): Classic at 128 by 128 pixels. Uses a 16-block radius, at most two chunks per server tick and no exclusions. Construction copies the location; it does not read or load the world.
      Parameters:
      camera - camera position/orientation, with the world to capture
      Returns:
      immutable request; required chunks must already be loaded when captured

    • at

      public static CaptureRequest at(org.bukkit.Location camera, RenderSettings settings)
      Starts a request with radius 16 blocks, at most two chunks per server tick and no exclusions. Construction copies the location; it does not read or load the world.
      Parameters:
      camera - camera position/orientation, with the world to capture
      settings - render dimensions, quality and resource limits
      Returns:
      immutable request; required chunks must already be loaded when captured

    • withRadius

      public CaptureRequest withRadius(double radiusBlocks)
      Returns an immutable copy with a finite positive capture radius. Provider limits still apply.
      Parameters:
      radiusBlocks - finite positive capture radius in world blocks
      Returns:
      copied request with the new radius

      public CaptureRequest withChunksPerTick(int chunksPerTick)
